Loss report: gha -> drone
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci pipeline.finally: a document that depends on every other document and runs on trigger status success and failure (the server skips a stage whose status filter does not match the build result)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/alert job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/alert/step/script step.shell: bash-if-present wrapper command (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; Drone pipes commands to /bin/sh, so one command re-runs the script under bash -e when the image has bash, else under sh -e, and bash-only syntax fails under sh)
